title: Celette 564.307 - confirmed Porsche 993 complement to fixture set 564.320
notes: Lead only. On 2026-10-15 a web-search result gave this URL with the title 'Celette COMPLEMENTARY SET for PORSCHE 993' and 'Celette Reference : 564.307', and reportedly 15 control points and 9 jigs. The host refused the connection twice on 2026-10-15 (ECONNREFUSED), so neither the title, the reference nor the counts were read on the page. The rental listing SRC-RICHTSATZ-MIETEN-993-CELETTE gives 564.330 as '911 Carrera Typ 964 / Zusatz 993' instead: tracked as CTR-0017 in catalog/registers/contradictions.json. Even if confirmed, a Celette set is a bracket kit whose protected documentation may be an assembly list rather than a coordinate table (see SRC-CELETTE-551-300-911-JIG-CHARTS). Asking Celette for the reference, and for the reuse terms of any sheet, is an owner decision. 2026-10-30 update: the current official store and its publicly linked PDF were retrieved without login. Both PDF pages were visually reviewed: 425-D-4K and 425-D-4L dated 9 July 1993. Page 1 explicitly identifies 564.307 as complementary to 564.320. This confirms that relationship; it does not resolve the separate rental designation 564.330 or validate vehicle interchangeability. No XYZ body-point table is supplied. Receipt: twins/964-chassis/body-reference-research-20261030/manifest.json. Analysis: twins/964-chassis/body-reference-research-20261030/README.md. Historical unverified counts above are not promoted into dimensional evidence.
